summary.pt: Um crime. Uma testemunha. Desde quando julgando por aparência não se desvenda um crime?
summary.en: One crime. One witness... that judge people by their appearances. What could go wrong?

pt: One crime. One witness. But judging by appearances is never that simple...
One player is the witness to a terrible crime. All other players are detectives.
Each round, the detectives ask the witness a yes-or-no question.
Then, the detectives must eliminate at least one suspect.
If the detectives eliminate the criminal, everyone loses.
When only two suspects remain, the group must decide who the criminal is. If they guess correctly, everyone wins.
There’s a catch: the witness cannot describe physical appearance. Their answers are based on appearance, but they can’t say how.
